svg.aria-label: No Xcode project: A Swift package and one settings file become a real Mac app.; Extensions: Widgets and other extensions go into PlugIns with the app's identifier and version.; Translations and icon: Every .lproj folder, and an icon in all sizes from one picture or one command.; Permissions that stay: A self-signed identity keeps Full Disk Access and other grants across rebuilds.; Disk image: The app, a link to Applications and your guide, signed, in dist/.; Notarized: With a Developer ID and a notary profile, macOS opens it without a warning.
